name: Bare Fare yellow (2014)
description: Yellow all over, belly and fin included; 'spirit' in huge black heavy lower case across the forward fuselage from the windows down past the engine; 'spirit' again in black on the fin, set diagonally up toward the tip; yellow engines with 'spirit.com' in black.

sources.title: Wikipedia: Spirit Airlines
sources.note: The 2014 yellow livery; Spirit ceased all scheduled operations on 2 May 2026.

sources.title: Spirit Airbus A320neo N967NK on final approach to Boston Feb 2025.jpg (CC BY 4.0)
sources.note: N967NK left side, 2025-02-01: titles, fin title, engine title.

sources.title: Spirit Airbus A321neo N713NK BWI MD1.jpg (CC BY-SA 4.0)
sources.note: N713NK, 2025-10-22: the same scheme on an A321neo, among the last before the shutdown.

logos.description: A small US flag under the registration on the rear fuselage.

titles.style: Spirit's wordmark: ultra-heavy geometric lower case in black, enormous, its x-height filling the side from the windows down; the p's descender reaching toward the wing root.
The wordmark again on the fin, rotated about 50° to read upward parallel to the leading edge, from the root's middle to near the tip's trailing corner.
Heavy lower case with '.com', along the cowling's side.

notes: Drawn from N967NK (A320neo, Feb 2025), seen slightly from below. The fin title is rotated, which the title fields can't express: its start is given, the angle is in the style. No later scheme was introduced before Spirit stopped flying on 2 May 2026. Re-checked 2026-11-15 on N967NK fitted to the measured A320 shape (photo_trace.py probe): the fuselage title runs x 0.221 to 0.55 (its end under the wing), baseline y -0.135, lowercase y -0.135 to 0.52 (about 1.9 m tall; the t and the i-dots barely rise above it, so xHeight is high); the fin title starts at fin (0.37, 0.04) and runs about 4.9 m up at 46° (length is a share of the root chord, 0.95), lowercase about 0.8 m; the engine title runs 0.21 to 0.84 of the nacelle, seen a little foreshortened. The fin title is now a turned title (rotationDeg).
history: Replaces Skyarium v1's approximate standard (a few colors from memory). The yellow 'Bare Fare' scheme replaced Spirit's previous scheme from 2014 and was the last; Spirit ceased scheduled flights on 2 May 2026.
